```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(parsnip)

# Helper packages

library(readr)       # import danych
library(broom.mixed) # konwersja 
library(dotwhisker) 
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
df = read.csv("insurance.csv")
```

```{r}
print(head(df))
```


```{r}
#| echo: false

df |> is.na() |> as.tibble()|>  summarise_all(sum)
```

```{r}
df |> summary()
```
```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = smoker)) + geom_bar()
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = sex)) + geom_bar()
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = df, aes(x = region)) + geom_bar()
```
